Synopsis:
    Shell's North American unit is selling its 609 MW gas-fired RISEC power complex in Rhode Island to Constellation Energy for $715M, while separately acquiring 100% of Hunlock Creek Generating (169 MW gas, Pennsylvania). Both moves are strategically aimed at expanding Shell's position in the PJM Interconnection market, driven by surging power demand from data centers. Constellation gains a New England foothold where tight supply has elevated electricity prices. Both deals require regulatory approval and are expected to close Q1 2027.
